type.description: An open list (ADR 0181): the core's types, tranibor.workitem.created, tranibor.workitem.state_changed, tranibor.workitem.closed, tranibor.workitem.human_requested, tranibor.workitem.human_decided, tranibor.workitem.workflow_failed, tranibor.workitem.migrated, tranibor.workitem.migration_refused, tranibor.workitem.status_comment_missed, tranibor.run.queued, tranibor.run.started, tranibor.run.progress, tranibor.run.finished, tranibor.finding.reported, tranibor.finding.created, tranibor.finding.duplicate, tranibor.finding.dismissed, tranibor.cost.recorded, tranibor.cost.alert, tranibor.project.provisioning.step, tranibor.project.provisioning.completed, tranibor.project.provisioning.failed, tranibor.security.injection_suspected, tranibor.tool.called, tranibor.network.denied, tranibor.action.proposed, tranibor.action.decided, tranibor.action.effect_done, tranibor.action.effect_compensated, tranibor.action.succeeded, tranibor.action.failed, tranibor.action.settled, and the types an installed extension declares (the release train's `tranibor.release.*` are the software-delivery plugin's since round D). A type under the former `choregos.` prefix is accepted and read as its `tranibor.` twin until 0.32.0 (ADR 0226). The platform refuses any other.
